title: 列車轉向架更換設備~Bogie-exchange equipment
focus: 轉向架更換的載重分配同步與定位~Load sharing synchronization and positioning in bogie exchange
summary: 本課聚焦轉向架更換的載重分配同步與定位。從車體承載點平均反力建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把多點吊升高度差與升降設備穩態散熱連成可驗證的介面，最後以設備驗證與證據重播整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies load sharing synchronization and positioning in bogie exchange. Start with mean reactions at body supports to define physical or information boundaries, connect height mismatch during multipoint lifting with steady cooling of lifting equipment as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through equipment verification and evidence replay. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2015 年品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對轉向架更換的載重分配同步與定位而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用偏心載重重新分配及交換作業互鎖狀態連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2015: The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For load sharing synchronization and positioning in bogie exchange, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through redistribution under eccentric loading and interlocked states of exchange work. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究車體承載點平均反力。原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。公式 y=m*g*factor/points/1000，代入得 y=50.7667 kN/point。邊界：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。敏感度只改 m=18000 至 19800 kg，輸出變為 55.8434 kN/point；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究偏心載重重新分配：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先用假想車體重量估算平均反力，再強調實際重心與支承剛度必須另有量測證據。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate mean reactions at body supports. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Formula y=m*g*factor/points/1000 gives y=50.7667 kN/point. Boundary: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. For sensitivity, change only m=18000 to 19800 kg; the output becomes 55.8434 kN/point. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate redistribution under eccentric loading: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. First estimate mean reaction from an assumed body weight, then emphasize that actual centre of gravity and support stiffness require separate evidence. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 車體承載點平均反力~Mean reactions at body supports
units.title: 車體承載點平均反力~Mean reactions at body supports
units.mechanism: 本單元先用假想車體重量估算平均反力，再強調實際重心與支承剛度必須另有量測證據。平均吊點反力來自總重量分配，但實際分力受重心位置、支承剛度與同步誤差控制。動態倍率只是概念帳項，不能取代設備認證；把總能力除以吊點數也無法證明最不利吊點仍有足夠承載餘裕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。~First estimate mean reaction from an assumed body weight, then emphasize that actual centre of gravity and support stiffness require separate evidence. Mean lifting reaction follows total load distribution, while actual reactions depend on centre of gravity, support stiffness and synchronization error. A dynamic factor is a conceptual accounting term, not equipment certification. Dividing total rating by support count does not establish margin at the most heavily loaded point. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。公式 y=m*g*factor/points/1000，代入得 y=50.7667 kN/point。邊界：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Formula y=m*g*factor/points/1000 gives y=50.7667 kN/point. Boundary: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating.
units.verify: 在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。以「車體承載點平均反力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution. For mean reactions at body supports, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 一個吊點不同步會把載重移往其他支承，總載重不變也可能局部超載並扭曲車體。回到「車體承載點平均反力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A lagging support transfers load to others; unchanged total weight can still produce local overload and body distortion. Trace the input chain for mean reactions at body supports. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載~Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded.
units.practice: 只把總吊升質量 m 從 18000 改成 19800 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 50.7667 變為 55.8434 kN/point。先說明「車體承載點平均反力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only lifted mass m from 18000 to 19800 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 50.7667 to 55.8434 kN/point. Explain the causal direction for mean reactions at body supports, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 偏心載重重新分配~Redistribution under eccentric loading
units.title: 偏心載重重新分配~Redistribution under eccentric loading
units.mechanism: 本單元比較車內設備偏置造成的左右反力，核對總和相同但單點載重可能增加的情況。兩支承反力由力與力矩平衡同時決定。重心偏向一側時，該側反力增加而另一側減少，總和仍不變；平均反力看似充足不能掩蓋單側限制，支承接觸若脫離還會改變原先的邊界條件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。~Compare left and right reactions caused by offset onboard equipment, checking how one support can gain load while the total remains unchanged. Two support reactions follow both force and moment equilibrium. Moving the centre of gravity toward one support raises that reaction while reducing the other without changing the total. Adequate mean reaction cannot hide a local limit, and loss of contact changes the assumed boundary conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.
units.verify: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。以「偏心載重重新分配」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. For redistribution under eccentric loading, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。回到「偏心載重重新分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Trace the input chain for redistribution under eccentric loading. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變~Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
units.practice: 只把重心偏心 e 從 0.4 改成 0.44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變為 122 kN。先說明「偏心載重重新分配」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only centre-of-gravity eccentricity e from 0.4 to 0.44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 120 to 122 kN. Explain the causal direction for redistribution under eccentric loading, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 液壓推力與保持~Hydraulic force and holding
units.title: 液壓推力與保持~Hydraulic force and holding
units.mechanism: 本單元以隔離縮尺台核對壓力與力，另觀察停留漂移並說明壓力表不等於機械保持證據。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。~Compare pressure and force on an isolated scale rig, separately observing holding drift and explaining why a pressure gauge is not evidence of mechanical retention. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1. Formula y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000 gives y=86.4 kN. Boundary: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立力感測器核對壓力推算，並記錄停留時的位移漂移與油溫變化。以「液壓推力與保持」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare pressure-derived force with an independent load cell and record displacement drift and oil temperature during holding. For hydraulic force and holding, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 內洩漏可造成保持位置下降但壓力讀值短時正常，空氣混入則可能使動作變軟並延遲。回到「液壓推力與保持」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Internal leakage can cause sag despite temporarily normal pressure, while entrained air makes motion compliant and delayed. Trace the input chain for hydraulic force and holding. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位~A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
units.practice: 只把油壓 p 從 12 改成 13.2 MPa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 86.4 變為 95.04 kN。先說明「液壓推力與保持」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only hydraulic pressure p from 12 to 13.2 MPa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 86.4 to 95.04 kN. Explain the causal direction for hydraulic force and holding, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 多點吊升高度差~Height mismatch during multipoint lifting
units.title: 多點吊升高度差~Height mismatch during multipoint lifting
units.mechanism: 本單元同步量測四個支承的高程，辨認位置差是原始零點偏移還是動作期間逐漸累積。小速度差會累積成高度差，長行程時尤其明顯。位置閉迴路可以限制累積，但感測器基準、通訊延遲和負載差異仍會影響同步；比較瞬間馬達轉速相同，並不足以證明各吊點的實際高度相同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~Measure elevations at four supports simultaneously, distinguishing an initial reference offset from mismatch accumulated during movement. A small speed difference accumulates into height mismatch, particularly over long travel. Position feedback can limit drift, but sensor references, communication delay and unequal loading still affect synchronization. Equal instantaneous motor speeds do not establish equal actual support heights. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：升降端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；升降端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。公式 y=(v1-v2)*t*1000，代入得 y=10 mm。邊界：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first lift speed v1=0.012 m/s; second lift speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s. Formula y=(v1-v2)*t*1000 gives y=10 mm. Boundary: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
units.verify: 用獨立高程量測核對兩端位置，分別比較空載與偏載情境的誤差累積斜率。以「多點吊升高度差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check both positions with independent elevation measurement and compare drift slopes for unloaded and eccentric-load scenarios. For height mismatch during multipoint lifting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共同位置零點錯誤可能讓控制器以為同步，車體卻已傾斜；某端摩擦突增則會出現斜率轉折。回到「多點吊升高度差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A shared zero-reference error can make the controller report synchronization while the body tilts; increased friction at one end changes the drift slope. Trace the input chain for height mismatch during multipoint lifting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩個馬達當下轉速相同就代表兩端高度永遠相同~Equal instantaneous motor speeds mean that both heights are always identical.
units.practice: 只把動作時間 t 從 20 改成 22 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變為 11 mm。先說明「多點吊升高度差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only motion time t from 20 to 22 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 10 to 11 mm. Explain the causal direction for height mismatch during multipoint lifting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 轉向架定位基準~Reference geometry for bogie positioning
units.title: 轉向架定位基準~Reference geometry for bogie positioning
units.mechanism: 本單元用小角度誤差估算定位點的橫向偏移，將地坪基準和車體基準分開核對。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。~Estimate transverse positioning error from a small angular error, checking floor references separately from body references. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
units.verify: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「轉向架定位基準」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For reference geometry for bogie positioning, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「轉向架定位基準」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for reference geometry for bogie positioning. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確~Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
units.practice: 只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「轉向架定位基準」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. units.anchor: 定位量測不確定度~Uncertainty of positioning measurements
units.title: 定位量測不確定度~Uncertainty of positioning measurements
units.mechanism: 本單元將重複量測分散與共同基準偏差分離，避免均方根合成讓固定定位偏差被縮小。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Separate repeated-measurement spread from shared datum bias, avoiding a root-sum-square calculation that artificially reduces fixed positioning error. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.verify: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「定位量測不確定度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For uncertainty of positioning measurements, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「定位量測不確定度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for uncertainty of positioning measurements. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號~Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
units.practice: 只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「定位量測不確定度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for uncertainty of positioning measurements, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 升降設備穩態散熱~Steady cooling of lifting equipment
units.title: 升降設備穩態散熱~Steady cooling of lifting equipment
units.mechanism: 本單元用等效持續功率估算液壓站或馬達穩態溫度，明確保留短時升降熱峰未被模型涵蓋。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Use equivalent sustained power to estimate steady hydraulic-unit or motor temperature, explicitly retaining short lifting heat peaks outside the model. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.verify: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。以「升降設備穩態散熱」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes. For steady cooling of lifting equipment, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「升降設備穩態散熱」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. Trace the input chain for steady cooling of lifting equipment. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱~A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
units.practice: 只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「升降設備穩態散熱」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only equivalent thermal resistance Rth from 0.035 to 0.0385 K/W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 61.5 to 64.65 degC. Explain the causal direction for steady cooling of lifting equipment, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 接觸與導向磨耗~Wear in contact and guidance parts
units.title: 接觸與導向磨耗~Wear in contact and guidance parts
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤導向輪與承載接點間隙，檢查磨耗率是否因偏載而改變並影響定位重複性。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。~Track clearance at guide rollers and support contacts, checking whether eccentric loading changes wear rate and positioning repeatability. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. Formula y=depth/cycles*future gives y=0.2 mm. Boundary: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.verify: 在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。以「接觸與導向磨耗」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation. For wear in contact and guidance parts, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。回到「接觸與導向磨耗」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. Trace the input chain for wear in contact and guidance parts. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變~The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
units.practice: 只把外推循環數 future 從 10000 改成 10001 cycles（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變為 0.20002 mm。先說明「接觸與導向磨耗」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only extrapolated cycles future from 10000 to 10001 cycles (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.2 to 0.20002 mm. Explain the causal direction for wear in contact and guidance parts, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 交換作業互鎖狀態~Interlocked states of exchange work
units.title: 交換作業互鎖狀態~Interlocked states of exchange work
units.mechanism: 本單元只在離線模型區分承載、移動與定位條件，檢查任何動作是否依賴尚未確認的支承狀態。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Distinguish support, motion and alignment conditions only in an offline model, checking whether a movement depends on an unconfirmed support state. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「交換作業互鎖狀態」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For interlocked states of exchange work, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「交換作業互鎖狀態」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for interlocked states of exchange work. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合~Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
units.practice: 只把布林變數數量 bits 從 8 改成 9 bits（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 256 變為 512 states。先說明「交換作業互鎖狀態」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only number of Boolean state variables bits from 8 to 9 bits (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 256 to 512 states. Explain the causal direction for interlocked states of exchange work, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 設備驗證與證據重播~Equipment verification and evidence replay
units.title: 設備驗證與證據重播~Equipment verification and evidence replay
units.mechanism: 本單元規畫空載與縮尺偏載試驗的證據保存，將初始支承設定和感測器校正一併納入重播條件。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Plan evidence preservation for unloaded and scale eccentric-load tests, including initial support setup and sensor calibration in replay conditions. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「設備驗證與證據重播」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For equipment verification and evidence replay, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for equipment verification and evidence replay. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果~All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
units.practice: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「設備驗證與證據重播」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for equipment verification and evidence replay, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
